summary: Iteration 3 RETEST — CRITICAL brute-force lockout fix VERIFIED. Pytest: 11/11 PASS (100%). The fix in /app/backend/server.py line 337 (`identifier = f'email:{email}'`) eliminates the previous k8s-ingress-IP-sharding bug; the counter now accumulates per-email regardless of which ingress pod proxies the request. Both TestBruteForce tests pass: (1) 5×401 then 6th=429 with Indonesian message containing 'menit', (2) a different email is NOT locked out after another email is locked. All regression tests still pass: auto-tx sync on Ready Stock create/update(mark-sold)/revert/delete, period filters on /api/cash-book and /api/profit-loss (this_month / last_month / this_year / all), /api/dashboard-chart returns 6 monthly buckets, and the end-to-end balanced scenario (BB kas 1,000,000 → buy 120,000 → sell 200,000 → aktiva 1,080,000 == pasiva 1,080,000, with laba_ditahan = 80,000). Cleared login_attempts collection after the run (3 docs removed) so future logins / tests are not blocked.

rca of the issue: RCA confirmed and FIXED. Previous identifier `f'{ip}:{email}'` used request.client.host which in this k8s deployment returns the ingress proxy pod's IP (observed 10.208.130.77 / 10.208.130.78). Round-robin between proxies sharded the failed-attempt counter across multiple login_attempts documents, so the per-document count never reached 5. Fix: scope identifier by email only (`f'email:{email}'`) — counter now accumulates regardless of which ingress pod handles the request. Verified by pytest TestBruteForce.test_lockout_after_five_failures (5×401 then 429 with Indonesian 'menit' in detail) and TestBruteForce.test_successful_login_clears_lockout (a different email is not locked when one email is locked).
